rows.label: tlk70000010_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Ever since we lost our
mother, I've had to be a
mum of sorts to Calcedo.

rows.label: tlk70000010_04_msg0002
rows.name:
I thought I considered Chalced more
than anyone, but I was only pretending
to think about him.

rows.label: tlk70000010_04_msg0003
rows.name:
He's gotten pretty big now, anyway.
Doesn't need me so much. Gives me a
bittersweet feeling to think on it.

rows.label: tlk70000010_04_msg0004
rows.name:
But thanks to him, I've got the most
reliable colleague I could ask for. I
really should be grateful.

rows.label: tlk70000010_04_msg0005
rows.name:
Yes, with Calcedo by my side, I feel
much stronger. Invincible! He's my
rock. That will never change!

rows.label: tlk70000010_04_msg0006
rows.name:
Oh..Laura! I nearly forgot...
Thank you so much!
